components.css: :host{--bg:#edf0f5;--surface:#fff;--ink:#0c1730;--ink2:#2c3852;--muted:#58637a;--line:#e3e7ee;--line2:#cdd3de;--wool:#0d1a35;--navy:#14284f;--navy2:#1f3a6e;--brand-soft:#e6ebf4;--gold:#c6a24a;--green:#137344;--green-soft:#e3f3ea;--amber:#8f5600;--amber-soft:#fcf0d9;--red:#b3261e;--red-soft:#fbe9e7;--r:14px;--r-sm:10px;--shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(13,26,53,.04),0 2px 6px rgba(13,26,53,.06);--lift:0 6px 18px rgba(13,26,53,.14);--font:'Barlow',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;--cond:'Barlow Condensed','Barlow',system-ui,sans-serif} .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font-family:var(--font)}.ds-lab{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink2);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.ds-lab span{font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}.ds-input{font:400 16px var(--font);color:var(--ink);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:12px 14px;min-height:48px;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}.ds-input::placeholder{color:#6b7590}.ds-input:focus{outline:0;border-color:var(--navy2);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(31,58,110,.18)}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Letter Jacket"**

The app wears the team's letter jacket. A deep navy wool shell (the rail, the phone header band, the next-game hero, the login field) holds crisp white leather panels set on a cool, navy-tinted ground. One thin line of varsity gold trims the jacket's edges, and every player is identified the way a jacket identifies him: by his varsity numeral, stitched into a felt patch.

The system is calm, sturdy and plainly athletic. It runs dense for coaches (a three-column desktop dashboard, sortable tables, availability grids) and roomy for parents on phones (48-50px touch targets, one task per card, a single save bar). Chest-lettering type, condensed and uppercase, names pages, cards and numbers; everything else reads in an even, friendly sans of the same family. It is explicitly not a grey SaaS dashboard with a blue accent: navy is the material, not the highlight.

Color carries meaning sparingly. Green, amber and red appear only where they say In, Maybe or Out (or done, pending, missing). Gold is trim, never fill.
keyCharacteristics: Navy wool fields for identity and the "what's next" moment; white leather cards for everything you read and edit.
One gold trim line per field: rail edge, phone header rule, hero top rule, active tab underline, patch ring.
The stitched numeral patch wherever a player is named.
One superfamily: Barlow for UI text, Barlow Condensed 700 uppercase for titles and numerals.
State colors only where they mean state; tabular numerals everywhere.

rules.name: The Gold Trim Rule
rules.body: Gold is a line, never a field. It appears as a 1.5-3px rule or ring at the edge of a navy or white material, at most one trim per surface.

rules.name: The State Means State Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red are reserved for In / Maybe / Out and done / pending / missing. Nothing decorative may borrow them.

rules.name: The Wool Is Material Rule
rules.body: Navy wool fills whole regions (rail, header band, hero, save bar); it is not used as a small accent on a grey page.

rules.name: The Chest Lettering Rule
rules.body: Condensed uppercase is reserved for names of things (pages, cards, sheets, the team) and for numerals. Sentences, buttons and labels on controls stay in regular Barlow, sentence case.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Body text runs `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so counts, dates and fees align in lists and grids.

rules.name: The Navy Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted with wool (rgba(13,26,53,…)), never neutral black, except the login card on the wool field.

dos: **Do** put a numeral patch beside every player name, sized to context (46 / 42 / 34 / 26px).
**Do** use wool for whole regions: rail, phone header band, hero, save bar, toast, login.
**Do** keep gold to one thin trim per surface (rail edge, header rule, hero top rule, active underline, patch ring, focus outline).
**Do** set page, card and sheet titles in Barlow Condensed 700 uppercase, and everything else in Barlow sentence case.
**Do** keep inputs at 16px text and 48px height, primary buttons at 50px, chips at 44px.
donts: **Don't** use green, amber or red for anything other than In / Maybe / Out or done / pending / missing.
**Don't** fill a region or a button with gold, or set text in gold.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface; the condensed cut is already the display voice.
**Don't** fall back to a grey page with a blue accent; navy is the material, white leather the surface.
**Don't** add uppercase eyebrow or kicker lines above titles; uppercase small labels are for table headers and date blocks only.
